'''Xun Tao''' was the leading figure of the movement that founded the [[People's Federation of Xanaqu]]. The extracted Xanaqu source identifies him as the leader of the [[Taoist Party]] demonstrations against the declining [[Bu Dynasty]] in late 1934 and as the commander or political leader associated with the Red Army victory in the [[Xanaq Civil War]].

This draft is a bridge page for Xanaqu's 1934-1936 formation chain. Xun Tao needs a fuller biography once canon exists for his early life, offices, writings, and later role.

== Role In Xanaqu's Formation ==

In late 1934, Xun Tao and the Taoist Party led peaceful demonstrations against the Bu Dynasty. After the dynasty collapsed, General Cheng Jin and the Xanaq Republicans attempted to form a rival northern state.

Xun Tao's Red Army defeated the republican forces in a short civil war. The new People's Federation was founded in 1936 and organized around worker councils, proletarian democracy, and the principles later associated with the [[Taoist Manifesto]].

== Legacy ==

Xun Tao became the central revolutionary reference point for Xanaqu and for later Taoist-inspired movements abroad. The [[Ryszard Flak]] source describes Flak in Mariposa as being inspired by Xun Tao's writings and revolutionary example, which later fed the [[Mariposa People's Liberation Front]] and [[Radical Taoism]].
